Name: Legendary Weapons
Author: DGlaky
Description:
The 24 weapons from other media can be purchased from Marlon's Shop for 100000g on different days of the week. The Prismatic Blade can be purchased from the Desert Trader for 250000g and 3 Prismatic Shards. This mod requires Content Patcher in order to run. Let me know if there are any additional weapons I should add in the future!
